title: Rav Asher Deutsch's First Yahrtzeit
body: Talmidim and followers of late Rav Asher Deutsch zt”l gather at his kever for his first yahrtzeit, a year after his passing.

title: Rav Mazuz Defends Yeshiva
body: BBC journalists visit Yeshiva Kisei Rachamim, where they speak with Rosh Yeshiva Rav Tzemach Mazuz about proposed legislation regulating lomdei Torah in Israel.
